provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Gruddirynn is centered at -72.283919, 77.633589 under Aristocracy, with 30,515,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Gruddirynn occupies 5,469,689.61 sq mi / 14,166,431.07 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.777373% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming and Ocean Surface floating settlement. Population density is 2.154 people/sq km / 5.579 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Triton, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Cog-Sanctum Synod, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Sigrananna, Setrimir, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 11 recorded four-province geography group links, including 8 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Elli Perkyn
npcs.description: Elli Perkyn is a Halfling case clerk whose cheerful steadiness keeps the Brass Concordat Detective Office from collapsing under cold tea, unpaid bills, and detectives with no instinct for paperwork. She schedules clients, tracks missing-person files, notices contradictions in witness statements, and remembers which grieving families need kindness before questions. Elli looks harmless until someone tries to bury a case; then every receipt, appointment note, and smudged transit stub becomes a weapon.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Umiotope is a City in Gruddirynn, under Aristocracy, with severe danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Halfling reads through the Halfling entry of the race compendium, within Halfling and Smallfolk, marked by Ishtanora. Halflings are small, cheerful folk known for luck, hospitality, and community bonds. They prefer peaceful living but are surprisingly resilient when threatened. Table cues: Brave, Halfling Nimbleness, Luck, Naturally Stealthy; starting tendency Altruistic - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Elli has solved more cases with calendars than some investigators solve with spells.
She keeps sweets in one drawer and emergency blackmail in another.
plotHooks: Elli asks the party to follow up on a client her detective dismissed as confused, because the dates are impossible.
A thief steals the office appointment book, not realizing Elli wrote a false schedule to catch them.
